clips.title: The story
paras: Mo'grosh Stronghold looms over the northeastern hills of Loch Modan. The fortified ogre den is dug among ancient ruins, and its inhabitants threaten the dwarven settlements below.

Mo'grosh ogres raid supply caravans in northeastern Loch Modan. From their caves and outer camps, they threaten travelers and the peace of Thelsamar. Rugged stonework scattered around the camp points to an older settlement. The ogres claimed the site and raised their distinctive mounds.
